items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to the Kings county health care facility transformation program
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7045

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the public health law, in relation
to the Kings county health care facility transformation program

 PURPOSE :

This bill would ensure that the $700 million in capital grants for the
above-mentioned program be awarded pursuant to an open and transparent
process.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section one of the bill would add a new subdivision five to section
2825-a of the Public Health Law to require that the agreement of the
commissioner of health and the president of DASNY include:

*a schedule or timetable for the issuance of the request for
applications, the receipt of applications and the awarding of the
grants; *a description of the process or procedures for determining
the amounts to be awarded to each applicant; and

*a description of how the grants will be distributed, administered and
monitored.

The section would also require that a public posting of all
applications received and the amount of the grant requested by, or to
be awarded to, each applicant; and that at least one public hearing in
the county of Kings be held prior to the awarding of the grants.

Section two of the bill provides that the act shall take effect
immediately.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Under the current law, the capital grants to be awarded pursuant to
the Kings county health care transformation program will be made by
the commissioner of Health and the president of DASNY without
competitive bidding.

As such, there is no way for the residents of Brooklyn or other
interested parties to know or learn the identity of the applicants,
whether the applicants in fact are eligible to receive a grant or the
amount of the grant until after the awards have been made.

This bill would require a more open and transparent process for the
awarding of capital grants under this program.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

Minimal.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
